gates.consent: no model/ request before the download button is pressed
gates.single_download: each model file is fetched from the server exactly once in the whole session (cancel recovery and page reload read Cache Storage)
gates.private_inference: no network request from the page or its Workers while any evaluation runs, and every request goes to the demo origin
gates.results: sample 0/2/5 completed Attempts match the official prompt hash, candidate order, judgment and probabilities; sample 6 (874 tokens) fails budget_exceeded after one provider call; reason none is not_selected with no provider call; duplicate IDs are rejected in the UI
gates.attempt: schema kaze_judge.attempt.v1; artifacts include the manifest files, bundle_manifest, wasm_engine (= deployed engine hash), prompt, rendered_prompt and policy
gates.save: the downloaded JSON equals the displayed Attempt, with top-level fields in kaze_judge::Attempt order
gates.repeat: results after cancel recovery and after page reload are bitwise equal to the first
gates.delete: after delete no pure-jeff-model cache remains and a reload shows the model as not downloaded

gates_external.consent: no request to the model host before the download button is pressed
gates_external.abort: after stopping a download while model.safetensors streams, it is not in Cache Storage and the UI shows the model as not downloaded with evaluation disabled; leftover partial data can be deleted from the page (delete enabled) and no cache remains afterwards
gates_external.single_download: after the second download click, model.safetensors is requested exactly once from the model host, and no model-host request follows the completed download
gates_external.hosts: every page/Worker request goes to the site origin, the model host or its download CDN (*.hf.co), over https except a local http site
gates_external.deployed: with --site-url, the deployed demo-config.json and engine.wasm equal the local build
